Stephen Jackson

Stephen Jesse Jackson

(Cap'n Jack, Stack Jack)

6-8, 218lb (203cm, 98kg)

Career Length: 14 years

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Stephen Jackson?

Stephen Jackson is 48 years old.

Where was Stephen Jackson born?

Stephen Jackson was born in Houston, Texas.

When was Stephen Jackson born?

Stephen Jackson was born on April 5, 1978.

How tall is Stephen Jackson?

Stephen Jackson is 6-8 (203 cm) tall.

How much did Stephen Jackson weigh when playing?

Stephen Jackson weighed 218 lbs (98 kg) when playing.

Is Stephen Jackson in the Hall of Fame?

Stephen Jackson is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Stephen Jackson drafted?

Stephen Jackson was drafted by Phoenix Suns, 2nd round (14th pick, 43rd overall), 1997 NBA Draft.

What position did Stephen Jackson play?

Small Forward, Shooting Guard, and Power Forward.

When did Stephen Jackson retire?

Stephen Jackson last played in 2014.

What is Stephen Jackson's net worth?

Stephen Jackson made at least $68,627,254 playing professional basketball.

How much did Stephen Jackson make?

Stephen Jackson made $10,059,750 in 2013.

What did Stephen Jackson average?

Stephen Jackson averaged 15.1 points, 3.9 rebounds, and 3.1 assists per game.

How many rings does Stephen Jackson have?

Stephen Jackson won one championship.

What schools did Stephen Jackson attend?

Stephen Jackson attended Lincoln in Port Arthur, Texas, Oak Hill Academy in Mouth of Wilson, Virginia and Butler County Community College.

What are Stephen Jackson's nicknames?

Cap'n Jack, Stack Jack are nicknames for Stephen Jackson.
